title: GCSE mocks: 3-week sprint (12 Nov to 2 Dec 2026)
note: Mocks assumed to start about Thu 3 Dec 2026 (not confirmed: shift the Monday start if needed). Weeks start Monday 9 Nov; the first 3 days are empty. Weekdays 5h, weekends 8h. Romeo and Juliet is not in the mocks, so it is excluded. German vocab = 750 new words by 26 Nov from the 1,790 master. Poetry = 15 poems x 3 quotes (Airtable). Geography = 19 case studies. Required practicals = 28 (Bio/Chem/Phys). Weak topics: Bio 4.6-4.7, Chem 4.9-4.10, Phys 4.7-4.8 (assumed). A day counts as done when the retrieval at the end hits about 80% closed-book.
targets: Daily: 30 min German vocab before school (50 new words until 26 Nov, then 100 review). 30 min closed-book retrieval at the end of each day.
Counts to hit: 45 poem quotes by day 5; 12 J&H anchors by day 7; 19 geography cases by day 14; 750 German words by day 15; 28 required practicals by day 11.
Checkpoints: day 7 (18 Nov), day 15 (26 Nov), day 21 (2 Dec).
No all-nighters. Sleep 8 hours. Phone away during blocks.
method: Close the notes and produce the answer. Mark every attempt with the official mark scheme; log every lost mark (paper | question | marks lost | why).
Retest missed items after 2 days and again after 7 days.
From day 16: timed sections only, marked strictly; the error log decides the repair blocks on days 19-20.
